title: Cold soba noodles with tofu and edamame
steps: Cook the soba for 4–5 minutes according to the packet, rinse in ice-cold water and drain.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes, dice the tofu and fry it in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes until golden.
Mix the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated ginger and 3 tbsp water into a sauce.
Arrange the noodles with cucumber strips, edamame and tofu, pour over the sauce and sprinkle with spring onions and sesame.
